answer: Use 3 jurors, 3 distinct subnets, 0 shared operators. A duplicate submission forfeits 100% of the stake. Standing drops 2% per idle epoch, so a 50-epoch-old key at zero activity is worth nothing. Numbers drive the design: a farm of 300 keys needs 900 juror draws, and each draw costs it a bond and a clean subnet. Forge the panel and you still face 3 reviewers who each lose a bond for a lazy pass. Idle seats shrink the grove: 10 epochs of silence and the account is a ledge, not a member.
